en.details: RSI Discovery Month is here, and so are new Twitch Drops! Celebrate the legacy of the Constellation and the arrival of its next generation by watching any Drops-enabled Star Citizen stream for a total of four hours to unlock the Phoenix Insignia Display for free. Inspired by the signature fiery insignia found aboard the classic Constellation Phoenix, this holographic display brings a piece of RSI history straight to your hangar.
